title: Should persistent notifications be associated with service worker registration or the scope?
body:
### What is the issue with the Notifications API Standard?

I just found that both Firefox and Safari associate the notifications with the scope instead for `getNotifications()`, while the spec says:

https://notifications.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-serviceworkerregistration-getnotifications

>Let notifications be a [list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of all [notifications](https://notifications.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-notification) in the [list of notifications](https://notifications.spec.whatwg.org/#list-of-notifications) whose [origin](https://notifications.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-origin) is [same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#same-origin) with origin, whose [service worker registration](https://notifications.spec.whatwg.org/#service-worker-registration) is [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this), and whose [tag](https://notifications.spec.whatwg.org/#tag), if tag is not the empty string, is tag.

Blink does the association as the spec says, and closes all the notifications when the SW is unregistered. I'm adding a tentative test in https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D202612 for Gecko/WebKit behavior as that's the majority, but worth a discussion.
